measuredSpectrum.source: Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1): Alekseeva et al. (1996, 1997), Baltic Astronomy 5, 603 and 6, 481; VizieR III/201. Procyon is HR 2943.
measuredSpectrum.note: Ground-based photoelectric scans by Pulkovo astronomers, combined into one absolute energy distribution per star with a stated accuracy of 1.5-2%. The catalogue gives no observation dates. HR 2943's column is read from the raw flux file, which lists seven stars per block.

crossCheck.source: Kiehling (1987), spectrophotometry of 60 bright F, G, K and M stars, 320-880 nm in 1 nm steps as normalised magnitudes: Kiehling (1987), A&AS 69, 465; VizieR III/124. * alf CMi is HR 2943.
